text: I have never felt so compelled to review anything as much as I feel I need to right now. Where to start...to begin, I only ever order a coffee and sometimes a bagel and hash brown, and typically I order ahead as it is very close from my office. My order is either ready when I get there or I am waiting 10+ minutes as the poorly staffed crew rushes around to fill the simplest of orders. Today, I witnessed the most disinterested crew member, Emmanuella I believe, read the little receipts on the bags over and over again instead of actually putting any item in them. She would pick a bag up, read it, put it down and repeat. The one time she did bring an order to a customer she dropped a milkshake and stood there for a solid 3 minutes before moving. Not only was her work ethic atrocious but she also looked like she wanted to kill herself and everyone in the restaurant. There had to be at least 10 people waiting in the tiny space for orders. Somehow I waited 5 minutes for my order to be taken and another 5 for it to be ready and throughout that entire time ONLY ONE PERSON RECIEVED THEIR ORDER WHICH HALF OF IT WAS SPILLED ALL OVER THE COUNTER BY OUR QUEEN EMANUELLA. From the time it has opened the location has been understaffed and it appears undertrained. I honestly think a pack of racoons could do a better job.
author: Leila-Ann Fife

text:
Bring hand sanitizer and a blow torch. Never seen a restaurant this filthy. The glass, the order kiosks, the floors, the front counter, and even the kitchen and manager were dirty, and it was only 10am on a Sunday.

Walked in quickly and ordered an Egg BLT McMuffin. Standing around waiting for my order, that I had no order# for, because the printers were broken (whatever), I notice bits of garbage basically everywhere, spills and grime covering every surface and every panel of glass, the curb, the floor, the front counter and behind the till into the kitchen. Again, this was only 10am on a Sunday. Refunded before my food arrived and it still took 12 mins from purchase to refund w no food. Avoid.
author: Mike P

text:
I wish I could give a Negative 5 rating if it were possible. The staff here is completely untrained. I visited with my family, including small children, and as we do not eat beef or ham, we specifically ordered chicken and egg breakfasts. Despite the restaurant not being busy, the wait time was very long.

By the time we realized there was a mistake, we were already on the highway heading from Ottawa to Toronto. My kids opened their food only to find ham inside. This was a massive disappointment and a complete lack of attention to detail. Our family has decided to ban McDonald's entirely from our future travels. We will not be returning.
author: suman C

text:
Tried to buy a $5 mcvalue breakfast sandwich, 2 can dine breakfast for $11.98, and a $1 hashbrown, and our cashier wanted to make us pay $31 dollars. The cashier looked dumbfounded as I listed the priced and food items so we had to leave, given that the long was getting longer and the manager wasn't helpful by adding another cashier on the line (there was only 1 cashier working when there is 2 cash registers).

I don't expect good experience from a mcdonalds, but this is the first time I met someone (Shammila - or something similar since i only took a glance) that couldn't do basic math as a cashier. Embarrassing.

text: I'm shocked McDonald's allows franchises to operate this way. They are the absolute slowest McDonald's in the country by far.
